IRON.description: Common structural metal used for hulls, station frames, and basic ship construction.

COPPER.description: Conductive metal used for electronics, power routing, and starter ship systems.

SILICATES.description: Rocky material used later for ceramics, insulation, and station modules.

ICE.description: Frozen volatiles used later for life support, reaction mass, and refining.

HYDROGEN.description: Light gas used later for fuel, coolant, and reactor feedstock.

HELIUM.description: Inert gas used later for cooling, shielding, and advanced industry.

METHANE.description: Carbon-bearing gas used later for fuel chemistry and plastics.

AMMONIA.description: Nitrogen-bearing volatile used later for fertilizer chemistry and life support inputs.

prospector.description: Small starter utility ship. Cheap, slow, and useful for basic mining and hauling.

hauler.description: Larger cargo ship reserved for later progression. Lower speed, high cargo capacity.

scout.description: Fast light ship reserved for later scouting and fog-of-war gameplay.

outpost.description: Default starter station. Stores unloaded materials and builds basic ships.

shipyard.description: Future upgraded station type for larger ship production.
